name: I AM NIGHT
detailed_description:
Overview

I Am Night is a roguelike deckbuilder where shadows stalk the road, fear takes form, and every card you play carves a new route through the dark. You play as Nox, a creative boy navigating a haunted world filled with twisted creatures, puzzling trinkets, and lurking horrors. Fight, flee, or manipulate the unknown using a deck of cards that you scrap together yourself.

Key Features

🕯️ A Living Deck – Build and refine a deck of modular cards. Cut them apart. Stitch them together. Forge unholy combos and wicked new forms.

🎭 Fear Has Many Faces – Battle monsters, mysteries, anomalies, and dangers—each fear type has its own behaviors, strengths, and trinkets.

🔪 Elegant Combat, Brutal Stakes – Resolve actions left to right, chaining effects across enemies. Target wisely, conserve your stamina, and embrace risk.

💀 A World That Remembers – Dynamic events and branching encounters reward your curiosity and punish recklessness. Each successive run builds on the last.

🧵 Handcrafted Horror Aesthetic – Inspired by paper dolls, folk tales, and late-night crafts gone wrong. Every card, enemy, and environment feels stitched together and barely holding.

🌕 Weather, Moon, and Madness – Runs are shaped by shifting moon phases and strange weather effects. A Blood Moon might bring ruin—or revelation.

Whether you're a tactician, a tinkerer, or just looking to lose yourself in a stylish nightmare, I Am Night invites you to play with fear—and be reshaped by it.
